mapper.select: select id, "name", category, "date", venue, status, price, description from "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" order by id

select "session".id, "session".activity_id, activity."name", "session"."date", "session"."time", "session".salesdate, "session".salestime, "session".capacity, "session".sold from "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" inner join "interviewworks_ticket".activity activity on "session".activity_id = activity.id order by "session".id
select orderno, customer, "name", "time", "date", "time", status, price from "interviewworks_ticket".ticket order by ticket.created_date, ticket.updated_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" ( id, "name", category, "date", venue, status, price, description ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{category}, #{date}, #{venue}, #{status}, #{price}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET "name" = EXCLUDED."name", category = EXCLUDED.category, "date" = EXCLUDED."date", venue = EXCLUDED.venue, status = EXCLUDED.status, price = EXCLUDED.price, description = EXCLUDED.description

INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket"."session" ( id, activity_id, "date", "time", salesdate, salestime, capacity, sold ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{activity_id}, #{date}, #{time}, #{salesdate}, #{salestime}, #{capacity}, #{sold} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET activity_id = EXCLUDED.activity_id, "date" = EXCLUDED."date", "time" = EXCLUDED."time", salesdate = EXCLUDED.salesdate, salestime = EXCLUDED.salestime, capacity = EXCLUDED.capacity, sold = EXCLUDED.sold
